title: SpatialContrastSettings
description: Settings for the SpatialContrast sync task.

window_size.description: Temporal-only contrast uses one spatial sample; spatial modes use an odd side length from 3 to 255 pixels.

temporal_window_size.description: Number of frames in the temporal window; 1 selects spatial-only 2D contrast, larger values select temporal or spatiotemporal contrast.

method.description: Direct sliding-window kernel or FFT-based box convolution.
